book.title: Shilǝn ki Lya a toh ɗǝ Malkus

content: Yesu Ndokǝl Mul ki Tle' ki Mi'gatli.
Kal ki mutti ten, nǝ palte' Kapalnahum, is kummi ti a libi.
I' mbalǝn dom ga diɓǝlli, lu zǝ' a sǝn ma ɗawai, abi dlabi ma. A Yesu ɗǝ pi'si shilǝn ki Lya.
Mbalǝn upsi is mbǝ, is kam Mulǝn tyai ki tle ki mi'gatli.
Saman tǝla'ti ma Yesu wai tǝngaki diɓǝtl ki mbalǝn, is mbulǝn gabini tu' malu u nǝ Yesu ɗa u nǝs mbul gabini u, is shim muli suɗi, nǝ lu muttuwasi.
Nǝ Yesu en lati mbatluwasǝn u i' ulmul ki tle ki mi'gatlisu, “Yakuyini a paci bazǝn lǝɓa wagi.”
Mbalǝn mi' lashti zhil ki Musa siki dǝmi a lǝbi, a si shilǝn a mbadli,
A si ussu, “Ya lakiɗa mulu ɗǝ shilǝn nǝgu? Pǝli' Lya bezǝn lǝɓa ti ɗa! Wokǝn ma' wokǝli yakǝn mbalǝn
bezǝn lǝɓa wasi ǝnbǝ Lya kǝn nǝmmwai u?”
Alǝbi alǝbi i Yesu man ulnǝ si dlǝmti a mbadlu, i Yesu ulsisu, “Yakǝn laki ɗa ki unndi shilǝn u a mbadlwakǝn?
Gukǝn ngǝtli nǝ mbǝlǝ, ti ulmul ki tle usu, ‘A wokǝli bezǝn lǝɓa wagi’ nǝ ta usu, ‘Hilya kam lumuttwagi ki zǝgaya?’
Ami lyamti ki manini Yakǝn mbalǝn
ti nǝ ndǝtl ki wokǝl bezǝn lǝɓa a dǝplaɓa.” I' ul mul ki tle ki mi'gatli su
“A ulkisu, hilya kam lumuttuwagi ki zǝga libi.”
I Alǝbi alǝbi tǝ hilya, i' kam lumuttuwa si, i' peki a kum mbalǝn ɗǝ yetti, a si kup gagashinti, a si natl Lya asi ussu, “Ma en ulǝn nǝgu gason wai.”
Taki' Lawi bi
Yesu peki i' lǝ bi Dlǝlka ki Galili ɗa ɗanu, Mbalǝn diɓǝli is domga a malgǝn wasi, ati kulcisi.
A ti beuti, i' en Lawi yakǝn ki Halpa ki dǝmi ati kyautǝn ki ka' upki ban. I Yesu ultisu, “Bǝlǝn kali.” I' hilya i' bǝlti kali.
Gason Yesu ɗǝ ɗap ulki ɗami a libi ki Lawi, mul ka' upki ban ne mi'bezǝn lǝɓa nǝ mbalǝn diɓǝli si ɗamti ne'ti ne mil kushti wasi, tǝn gaki mil diɓǝlti gesi mi' bǝtlti ni;

Nǝ mi' lashti zhil ki Musa si palisiyawani is enti ɗǝ ɗamti nesi, nǝ mi'bezǝn lǝɓa nǝ mi' ka' upki ban u, is ul mi' kushti wasisu, “Ya laki ti ɗamti nǝ tleti ne' mi' kap upki ban nǝ mi'bezǝn lǝɓa ɗa?”
Nǝ Yesu kumi nǝgu u, i' ulsisu, “Mi' ginǝ bǝ ɗa gontwai u sikǝn lǝ' mamul pǝtl igǝn wai, mi' gonti si ɗǝ ngau mul igǝn. Tǝn gaki mi' pǝtl ze kautǝnkǝn a mbǝɗawai, tǝn gagi mi' bezǝn lǝɓa ni.”
Gyemti a Tǝn pǝtl Kuzǝn Mali
Mi' kushti ki Yahaya mul baptisma nǝ ki palisiyawa si pǝtl kuzǝn mali. Mbalǝn en ngem Yesu is usu, “Yalaki ɗa mi' kushti ki Yahaya nǝ ki palisiyawa si kuzǝn mali gwaɓo si ɗa pǝtl ti wai?”
I Yesu ulsisu, “Yelǝnsi ki mul kutleti sǝn pǝtl kuzǝn mali a mul kutleti nesiya? Tunnǝ mul kutleti nesi u sǝkǝn pǝtl kuzǝn malilwai,
Cin ɗǝ mbǝti sinkap mul kutletiyi taka ɗǝ masi. Cinisini sǝn pǝtl kuzǝn mali.
Kǝn ca'ti mbulǝn gǝsi nǝ pyal lulutwai. In a caki nǝ nali u, pyal luluti nǝn kyeshti gus lulutisi, nǝn ngǝtlti ki kal nǝ kyeshti.

Kǝn bǝna pyal mal ki mil pǝ' ki annabi ge gus kal ki bati wai. Mun nǝ a bine u, mali si nǝn tatlti kal ki bati si, a hol kal nǝ mal innabi isi. Pyal mal ki mil pǝ' ki innabi, sai nǝ pyal kal ki bati.”
Mi' Kushti Ki Yesu Go' Cotlti Alkama Cin shuti
Gason cin shuti, Yesu ne mil kustiwasi si ɓeuti ge' gu ki alkama. Sige ɓeuti i mil kusti ki Yesu is go' catl ga alkama en.
I palisiyawa ultisu, “En ulnǝ mil kushtiwa ɗǝ pǝlti u. Ya laki ɗa si pǝtl ulnǝ zhil ki Musa a ndigi ti pǝlti cin ki shutwai u?”
I Yesu njesi shilǝn nisi i' ulsisu, ka kummǝn shilǝn ki ulnǝ Dawuda pǝli u waiya, cin u nǝ kuzǝn gopti, ti ne' yelǝnsi lǝtwaswaiya?
Hwon u nǝ Abiyatal tiki bal lǝɓa, Dauda tege' Libi ki Lya, i' ɗam biledi gunǝ zǝdli u iki bǝl yalǝnsiwasi ginǝ ne'tu, ki ɗami ki lǝɓasi ni nǝgwasǝn mulǝn kǝn ɗamtwai.
I Yesu ulsisu, “Pǝlǝn cin shuti tǝngaki mbalǝn, ba pǝlǝn mbalǝn gaki cin shutuwai.
Yakǝn mbalǝn kǝnki mulban ki shuti nǝ ki cin shuti.”
